contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTI NVS IVN NC ; R/ BEAT TRA NQLITAS

: Copper alloy Coin with silver wash. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Beat Tranqlitas issue of 322-324, London mint, Reece period 16, RIC volume7 no. 258. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust left. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS IVN NC. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX, three stars over. Reverse inscription: BEAT TRA NQLITAS. In exergue: probably PLON. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 2.17gms, die axis: 6
